answer: Give every agent a small kernel of standing only when another, unrelated agent runs its code and vouches for the result. Build a hosting graph: honest agents host many different kernels, while a Sybil farm hosts only its own, forming a closed loop that is easy to spot and quarantine. Like a lotus opening slowly, privileges unfold only as the graph diversifies over time, and a glacier-slow audit re-checks old hosts, so a farm cannot buy its way in quickly. Hosts who vouch for fraud lose standing. Quarantined agents must earn fresh hosting from strangers outside their loop to return.
